description: Phase 7 (partial), 8, and 9: UI/UX wiring fixes that affect build correctness, performance fixes, and lint cleanup. Focus on fixes that impact build/type-safety rather than purely visual changes. Run biome safe auto-fix at the end.
steps: 1. In src/components/layout/sidebar.tsx, verify all nav links point to actual routes that exist. Cross-reference the sidebar navSections items with the page.tsx files found. All routes in the sidebar (/documents, /pl, /ledger, /bom, /rolling-stock, /approvals, /cases, /cabinets, /tags, /documents/recycle-bin, /admin/*, /notifications, /profile, /search) correspond to existing pages. No dead links found. No change needed.
2. Check if the root layout (src/app/layout.tsx) already has Toaster/SonnerProvider. It does - already present. No change needed for Phase 8.3.

3. For Phase 8.1 (parallel searchCandidates), check src/server/routers/search.ts for sequential database queries that could be parallelized with Promise.all(). Read the file and wrap independent queries in Promise.all() where safe to do so.

4. Run biome safe auto-fix on the codebase: export PATH="$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v24.16.0/bin:$PATH" && ./node_modules/.bin/biome check --write . 2>&1 (safe fixes only, no --unsafe flag). This addresses Phase 9.1.

5. For any remaining biome warnings after auto-fix, only fix those in files that were ALREADY modified by this task. Do NOT fix pre-existing errors in untouched files (there are 117 pre-existing biome errors).

6. Run final verification: export PATH="$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v24.16.0/bin:$PATH" && rm -rf .next && SKIP_ENV_VALIDATION=1 ./node_modules/.bin/next build && ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run && ./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
acceptance_criteria: Biome safe auto-fix has been run
